faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CRP-EP posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the CRP-EP posts is 04 September 2026. Candidates are advised to ensure their applications reach the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum age requirement for the CRP-EP posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the CRP-EP posts is 18 years. There is no upper age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the CRP-EP position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the CRP-EP position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 1000.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the CRP-EP posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th standard (10th Pass) to be eligible for the CRP-EP posts.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the CRP-EP posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies available for the CRP-EP posts in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the CRP-EP posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the CRP-EP posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the CRP-EP recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on minimum eligibility criteria, academic qualifications, experience, and other socio-economic cum special category factors.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Baba Sanischar Block Level Federation, Bhandaripokhari Block (Baba Sanischar BLF).

faq.answer: The job type for the CRP-EP posts is contractual.
